purpose: 11 further complete home kits; dated evidence, no original game writes

entries.note: Black shorts with amber inserts and black socks with amber branding complete the published strip. Plain amber shirt mapping is retained.
Black shorts with white accents and white socks with black turnovers are documented for 2026/27, rather than the prior year's black socks.

entries.sourceClassification: Season-matched O'Neills release with independent corroboration
entries.note: Blue shorts and blue socks with white foot detail complete Wigan's home kit. SWOS cannot reproduce the white foot detail.
White shorts and navy socks accompany the anniversary shirt. Black is used as the available nearby dark navy sock colour in SWOS.
White shorts with red and blue detail complete the kit; previously verified black socks with blue and red trim are preserved.

entries.sourceClassification: Season-dated Umbro report and local newspaper corroboration
entries.note: Black shorts and royal blue socks complete the home strip, with white sock turnovers and yellow details simplified in SWOS.

entries.sourceClassification: Season-specific Reebok full-kit report and official kit shop
entries.note: White shorts and white socks accompany the white home shirt. Gold crest and Reebok markings are omitted from the SWOS palette.

entries.sourceClassification: Season-specific news report corroborated by official collection
entries.note: Amber shorts and amber socks complete the published home pairing. SWOS orange approximates amber without the shirt's fine detail.

entries.sourceClassification: 2026/27 Adidas full-kit report and current club shop
entries.note: Black shorts and white socks complete the red-and-white home strip. Thin pinstripes and shoulder markings are omitted in SWOS.

entries.sourceClassification: Official club social storefront lists season and both component colours
entries.note: The club's official link collection lists royal blue 26/27 home shorts and socks; the local launch report corroborates the season.

entries.sourceClassification: Current-season independent match-kit usage report and official shirt
entries.note: November's kit-usage report distinguishes the normal all-blue home kit from a match-specific switch to away shorts and socks. Plain SWOS blue preserves the dominant colour.
